title: Total Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the total relativistic energy expression E' for the system in the center of mass frame.

title: Particle Momentum Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should accurately calculate the particle's momentum in the center of mass frame, ensuring the use of the correct transformation equations.

title: Final Photon Momentum
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the momentum of the final photon in the laboratory frame after scattering.

title: Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply conservation of momentum and energy correctly to relate the initial and final momenta of the photon and particle.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes when calculating momenta, particularly in the context of elastic scattering.
